name: Post-Crisis: Applied Limits
truth: Knowing the limits of formalization, what do we build?
qfep_connection: After the foundations crisis, these maps explore what happens when incompleteness, bias, and rhizomatic thinking become design materials rather than problems to solve.
description: The last sequence turns the museum back towards its makers. Each hall exposes a different decision: what can be distinguished, who can participate, what survives disagreement, where a claim comes from, how contributions accumulate, which connections form, which bodies a catalogue permits, and what we will change next.
learning_objectives: Separate authored spatial compression from measured model behaviour
Compare how count, scale and arrangement shape participation
Distinguish retaining a conflict from changing inference rules
Keep a claim, its source and its criteria distinguishable
Distinguish contribution counts, contributor identity and revision
Inspect how nearest-neighbour growth distributes connections
Separate authored assembly targets from the motion towards them
Propose a specific change, observe its consequence and test its reuse
